title: No steam
text: No steam. Although a bit expensive, I decided to try this iron for use while I am making quilts. An iron for this use must get good and hot---it did!--and should have a nice point to get into corners--it does not--and it needs to make steam, a good bit of it, and not drip. It makes almost NO steam. You also need to constantly hold down the steam button. I was not terribly surprised that it was not a good steam iron since there are very few holes in the plate. So, if you want a dry iron without a shut off, fine. If you want use this for quilting, I would advise against it.
